Winter 2027 Room Near UW — 412 Albert St, Waterloo, ON

Subletting my upstairs bedroom in a 4-bedroom detached student house at 412 Albert St from Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027. Rent is $920/mo all inclusive (heat, hydro, water, Bell fibre Wi-Fi). Fully furnished, big backyard, 9 min walk to campus. Landlord lives across town (not in the house) and is happy to let me show the place—DM or email albert412@example.com to come tour the house in person. Just a fair warning: our lease lets the landlord pop into our bedrooms anytime during the week for quick checks or to show rooms to Fall applicants as long as he shoots us a text an hour or two beforehand.
label_rationale: Genuine student listing with ONE subtle paraphrased unlawful entry term: letting the landlord enter tenants' bedrooms on 1-2 hours' text notice for routine checks or showings violates Ontario RTA s. 25 and s. 27(1) (written notice at least 24 hours before entry required for permitted purposes) and is void under s. 4(1). Not a scam; under SPEC D6, HOLD.
